title: Webhook Test
summary: Checks a webhook URL the way the sender will before it's saved: reachability, https, redirects, slow replies and login pages.
description: Webhook URL field that flags localhost and private IPs, plain http, a missing path and tunnel URLs, then judges a test delivery like the sender: redirects fail (one-tap switch to the final URL), slow replies near the timeout and 200 login pages are caught.
catches: localhost, private and link-local IPs the sender can't reach
Missing path and temporary tunnel URLs
Redirects, with a switch to the final URL
Replies close to the sender's timeout (default 10 s)
200 responses that are really login pages
limits: Test delivery runs through your onSendTest; results depend on where it's sent from
Hostname checks don't resolve DNS, so names pointing at private IPs aren't caught
a11y: Visible <label>; status via aria-describedby in a polite live region
Fix and send buttons have text labels
server: Validate webhook URLs server-side (resolve DNS, block private ranges) to prevent SSRF, and sign deliveries.

sources.label: GitHub Docs – Best practices for using webhooks

rules.note: Confirmed GitHub asks receivers to respond within 10 seconds. Other senders use different timeouts; set timeout.

stops: Webhook saved to an unreachable URL
